description: Returns randomly chosen wiki pages from one namespace, as each page's title, page ID, and namespace ID; the API counterpart of Special:Random. One call's pages are a fair random sample; separate calls can overlap because they read the same ordering from different starting points. There is no continuation; each call picks a new starting point. For page content, pass the titles to get-pages.

filter.description: Filter the drawn wiki pages by redirect status

limit.description: Number of wiki pages to draw (1..500)

namespace.description: Namespace ID to draw wiki pages from

wiki.description: Wiki to target, as a key from the mcp://wikis/ resources (e.g. en.wikipedia.org), or the full mcp://wikis/ URI. Omit to use the default wiki.

name: get-random-pages
